title: Harbor Help Run
summary: A harbor briefing game where cursor movement and marker collection unlock the help panel.
instructions: Steer the cursor to collect markers and unlock the help panel before the harbor drifts away.

overlay.startCopy: Collect markers in the harbor to power up the help panel and complete the mission.

help.title: How To Start Help Panel Harbor
steps: Press Start in the center overlay.
Use the controls: Steer the cursor to collect markers and unlock the help panel before the harbor drifts away.
Follow the first goal: intro, pressure ramp, dense finish.
tips: Support mechanics: timed swap, pickup pressure.
